answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 150935 Country: India Title: Joining congregation Question: If a person prayed fardh salah individually, later that person has opportunity to join congregation. In which out of 5 times(prayer time) he can join salah? What is the case if that person is musafir? Answer ID: 150935 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 730/561/D=8/1438) (1) He should join in Zuhr and Isha as it shall be nafl . Further he will also get the reward of jamat. He should not join in Fajr and Asr because it is makrooh to offer nafl salah after these two salahs, and he should not join in Maghrib for there is no three rakah in nafl . (2) He is musafir , and has offered his fardh salah then the same the abovementioned ruling shall apply if he joins the jamat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
